review.note: Release 0.4.0 changes explicit local dependency project sources to ordinary distributions, retaining only the rebuilt repository itself as editable. The installed dependency module and METADATA now belong to its new venv and direct_url.json is written by uv without an editable flag; source edits no longer affect installed dependency bytes until the environment is rebuilt. This intentional breaking CLI contract has a documented one-time environment conversion: upgrade uv to >=0.13.0 and rerun the original rebuild command, preserving all application data. Two real stdlib build backend cases cover spaces, # and % through both path and file URI, normal dependency resolution, installed file inventory and isolated imports, and own-project editable updates. Three unsupported/malformed uv cases reject before any Python environment mutation. All 35 environment and 35 bootstrap/path regressions passed, as did the full fast checks; five corresponding tests fail against committed 0.3.4. The first complete pytest diagnostic run found stale bootstrap mock expectations; it was interrupted via its verified canonical owner with owned_tree_empty=True, those tests were updated and their 35-case slice passed. Canonical full gate remains separately required. No dependency bound or pin changes. Current registry discovery exactly matches the previously reviewed 0.3.4 Python and Node candidates: hatchling 1.32.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, Ruff 0.17.0, markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3; all Python candidates support Python 3.14 and satisfy the declared ranges. Previous release-note conclusions for those identical versions remain applicable. External bootstrap uv is now explicitly >=0.13.0. Official https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.11.27 documents encoded hash-path fix #19807; https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.13.0 documents the Python 3.15 default (our commands explicitly select 3.14), stricter constraints/editable handling (our editable own-project is in requirements, never constraints), cache refresh/rebuild and archive changes. Isolated uv 0.13.0 reproduced successful encoded path builds where installed 0.10.12 fails. Test fixture venvs are genuine Python venvs to respect new uv refusal to clear arbitrary directories; no --force workaround. Build fixtures use UV_NO_INDEX=1, UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never, fresh caches and stdlib-only backends because --refresh and UV_OFFLINE are incompatible. Global uv and all consumer repositories are unchanged by this toolkit task.
